title: Gartner Alert: Over $3.5 Trillion in AI Compute & Data Center Capex Risk Impairment by 2030
key_facts: More than $3.5 trillion of AI infrastructure spending could be exposed to impairment by the end of 2030 (Gartner).
AI providers expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure in 2026 and about $6 trillion in 2027 to 2030.
Owners would need $8.5 trillion cumulative revenue to cover spending, financing costs and a 12% return.
AI data-centre revenue is forecast at no more than $3.6 trillion through 2030.
A continued trajectory could leave over $4 trillion exposed to write-down risk through 2032.
Gartner does not expect the 12% return before the end of 2032 at the earliest.
AI-optimised infrastructure-service spending is to grow from $66 billion in 2027 to $174 billion in 2030.
Over 80% of neocloud providers will cease independent operations by 2030.
quote_evidence: In 2026, AI providers are expected to spend nearly $1 trillion on AI infrastructure, and are forecast to invest an additional $6 trillion between 2027 and 2030," said Will Sommer, Sr Director Analyst at Gartner.
By 2030, Gartner predicts that cost pressure and a lack of a differentiating business model will force over 80% of neocloud providers to cease independent operations.
why_it_matters_hint: AI revenue may not cover the cost of the buildout.
